verdict.rationale: A runtime probe of the npm registry shows @babylonjs/core is published under Apache-2.0. That is a permissive open-source license that carries no royalty or per-install fee obligations. The llms.txt probe also describes Babylon.js as an "open game and rendering engine". missing for 10: first-party licensing documentation explicitly stating no royalties or fees, coverage of licensing for the wider ecosystem (tools, Babylon Native, exporters), independent or community corroboration of commercial shipping terms.

support.subject: As a studio lead, the license is permissive with no royalties or per-install fees — I keep what my game earns

citations.quote: `npm view @babylonjs/core version` → 9.26.1 (Apache-2.0, 234,040 weekly downloads via the public npm API)
Babylon.js is a powerful, beautiful, simple, and open game and rendering engine
